missing_integration.M1_no_pause_or_exit_control: slice_server imports neither session_flow nor input_mapper and ships no /api/pause or /api/exit route; index.html binds no Escape/Q handler. The pause/exit legs of done_when therefore run through the SessionFlow over the REAL World lifecycle seam (Session B) - the module's own declared integration contract. The page/server-level wiring of pause/exit is the unresolved piece.
missing_integration.M2_no_exit_signal_path: the server installs no console/signal handler; its only graceful shutdown is KeyboardInterrupt -> its shipped `finally: WORLD.shutdown_engine()`. Delivering CTRL_C was measured impossible in this environment (a CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP child has CTRL_C disabled by the group flag; this process tree has no Windows console for a console-wide event; attach-console delivery returns TRUE but is unobserved by the child). A hard server kill ORPHANS the engine child (MEASURED in A4); the driver terminated its own orphan by PID. The app's own teardown is proven on the real engine in A3 (restart) and B7 (Q).
